description: Board-fabricated 12 mm round capacitive-touch electrode. It is not a purchasable component: pad 1 is F.Cu copper covered by solder mask, and the attached 16 mm B.Cu rule-area prohibits tracks, vias, pads, copper pours, and footprints beneath or within 2 mm of the electrode edge.
name: capacitive-touch-pad

provenance.source: manual from Microchip AN2934 layout guidance

sourcing.manufacturer-reference: Microchip AN2934 Capacitive Touch Sensor Design Guide, Button Sensor Design and Passive Shield

watch_out_for: The 12 mm copper diameter and 2 mm surrounding B.Cu keepout are reviewed AN2934 starting assumptions, not user-specified dimensions. The pad is intentionally solder-mask-covered, not bare copper; do not put silkscreen or another overlay in the active area. Do not fit a passive ground shield or any copper under the pad; tune acquisition and thresholds on the actual stackup, cover, and enclosure.
